notes.title: Rotten Sails - New Trailer & Open Playtest Next Week!
notes.content:
Ahoy sailors!

Rotten Sails has big news to share:

🎬 New Trailer
Expected date: End of April 2025  
Our new gameplay trailer drops next week, featuring real players braving the cursed waters!

🎮 Open Playtest: April 30 - May 6, 2025

 Thinking to make it open to everyone!
 Join our Discord for exclusive tips and to connect with other players
 Help shape the game with your feedback


The Black Armada awaits your service... if you dare.
